title: Alerts
description: The owner hears when something breaks: a notification on the map it broke in (through the notifications pack) and, for the server's own map, a mail to the operator through the walls (root.mail), once an hour at most for each thing. Other internal packs alert by its name, act.report.alert. A server-level service: versioned and pinned with the server by its operator, never turned on, off or versioned per island.
